title: aster foliaceus var. hesperius
intro: Aster foliaceus var. hesperius, commonly known as the Western or Cut-leaved Mountain Aster, is a perennial plant in the daisy family native to North America. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing relief from various health issues. The plant's health benefits include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and combat infections. The bioactive constituents of Aster foliaceus var. hesperius include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, contributing to its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects.
